name: Fridas Taqueria
notes: All 3 photos were digital menu boards for the Frida's Taqueria chain. Photo 3 shows the same board next to a POS screen reading 'Welcome to FRIDAS TAQUERIA VISTA', matching this restaurant's Vista, CA address, so its full item list and prices were used as primary. Photos 1 and 2 show the identical menu layout but with different prices on most lines (e.g. Tacos $3.79/$3.49, Torta $12.99/$10.99, Mulita $7.99/$6.99, Papa Asada $14.99/$13.99) and photo 2 additionally omits the Vampiro and Quesadilla lines; likely other locations or an older price sheet, so they were not used except to cross-check. Each category lists protein choices (Asada, Adobada/al pastor, Birria, Carnitas, Pollo Asado, Papas con Soyrizo, Chicharron, Cabeza) rather than being separate priced items.
